title: Kilian Jornet Burgada — UTMB Index race history
claims: The UTMB Index profile records Kilian Jornet's 30 June 2013 Marathon du Mont-Blanc as 42.2 km with 2,515 m of ascent, a time of 3:30:41 and first place out of 1,921 finishers.
The same profile records his 25 June 2017 Marathon du Mont-Blanc as 42.5 km with 2,780 m of ascent and a time of 3:45:45.
The same profile records his 1 July 2018 Marathon du Mont-Blanc as 42.7 km with 2,780 m of ascent and a time of 3:54:54.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取 UTMB Index 运动员公开档案，抄录 2013、2017、2018 三届 42 km 的距离、爬升与成绩。该档案是 UTMB 的赛事数据库，不是赛事官网的纪录页。
